description: This Java source file defines the class YarnShuffleServiceMetrics, which implements MetricsSource to forward shuffle metrics to Hadoop's metrics system within the Spark on YARN environment.

classes.name: YarnShuffleServiceMetrics
classes.description: Implements MetricsSource to collect and forward shuffle metrics to Hadoop metrics system, supporting Timer, Meter, Gauge, and Counter metrics.

classes.name: ShuffleServiceMetricsInfo
classes.description: A record implementing MetricsInfo, used to hold metric name and description.

methods.name: YarnShuffleServiceMetrics
methods.description: Constructor initializing metrics namespace and metric set.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Collects metrics from the metric set and adds them to the provided MetricsCollector.

methods.name: collectMetric
methods.description: Static method to process different metric types (Timer, Meter, Gauge, Counter) and add their data to the MetricsRecordBuilder.

methods.name: getShuffleServiceMetricsInfoForGenericValue
methods.description: Creates MetricsInfo for generic metric values with a base name and value name.
